svg.title: Yonix — Build, compare, and activate NixOS configurations.
svg.desc: Yonix builds, compares, and activates NixOS configurations. The terminal, desktop app, and browser panel connect to one shared Yonix daemon.

svg.title: Yonix
svg.desc: A folded blue ribbon in the shape of a single mirrored arm of the Nix snowflake.
svg.metadata: Nix Snowflake by Simon Frankau and Tim Cuthbertson, https://github.com/NixOS/nixos-artwork/tree/master/logo, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). One arm isolated, reflected, rounded and redrawn as a ribbon for Yonix.
